chalo-himachal.title: Chalo Himachal
chalo-himachal.description: Delhi → Manali → Kasol → Bir. Volvo both ways, Solang and Atal Tunnel, riverside camp in Kasol and a paragliding day in Bir.

stories.title: 10 strangers, one Volvo, and the best paragliding day of my life
stories.body: We met at Majnu ka Tilla as strangers. By Bir we had a group chat called "Volvo gang" and a plan to come back for the Billing take-off in March. Sanjay is the pilot to ask for.

stories.title: What I packed (and didn't need) for 10 days
stories.body: Ten days, one 40 L bag. Thermals and a power bank were gold. The third pair of jeans never left the bag.

rishikesh-weekend.title: Rishikesh Weekend
rishikesh-weekend.description: Rafting at Shivpuri, a riverside camp, Ganga aarti at Triveni Ghat and a café crawl in Tapovan.

rupin-pass-trek.title: Rupin Pass Trek (Alpine Style)
rupin-pass-trek.description: A 7-day crossing from Dhaula to Sangla over the 15,250 ft Rupin Pass. Hanging villages, waterfalls and snow fields.

bhutan-thunder-dragon.title: The land of thunder dragon, Bhutan
bhutan-thunder-dragon.description: Paro, Thimphu and Punakha with a guided climb to Tiger's Nest. SDF and permits handled.

stories.title: Bhutan on a budget: Paro, Thimphu and Tiger's Nest
stories.body: Paro, Thimphu and the climb to Tiger's Nest. The SDF adds up, so we split a guide and a car four ways.

trip.title: The land of thunder dragon, Bhutan

kasol-kheerganga.title: Kasol – Kheerganga Trek
kasol-kheerganga.description: Kasol cafés, the Kheerganga climb with hot springs at the top, and a night under the stars.

tungnath-chandrashila.title: Tungnath & Chandrashila
tungnath-chandrashila.description: Chopta camp, the world's highest Shiva temple at Tungnath and sunrise on Chandrashila.

stories.title: Tungnath at sunrise: worth the 4am start
stories.body: Chopta at 4am is cold and very dark. Chandrashila at sunrise is worth every step. Go in December for the snow.

spiti-winter-circuit.title: Spiti Winter Circuit
spiti-winter-circuit.description: Shimla → Kalpa → Kaza in deep winter. Key monastery, Langza, Hikkim post office and frozen streams.

valley-of-flowers.title: Valley of Flowers & Hemkund
valley-of-flowers.description: Govindghat → Ghangaria → the Valley of Flowers in bloom, and Hemkund Sahib.
